title: Let Him Make Your Heart His Own 291 / *

lines: Scripture; Revelation 3:20
Jesus is standing beside you,
Waiting to enter your heart;
Meekly and humbly entreating,
While He is tenderly pleading,
Don't let the Savior depart.
Why must you wait 'til the judgment,
So heavy laden with sin?
Sinner, there is no tomorrow,
Waiting will bring you but sorrow;
Open and let Him come in.
Open the door ere He leaves you,
Soon now His calling will cease.
While on you mercy is falling,
Answer to His gentle calling;
Now let your soul find release
Spurn not His last invitation,
Hear him before He is gone,
Do not forsake Him,
O sinner, Let your heart break, let him enter,
Let Him make your heart His own.
